name: Tristan Lee Bell
original_name: トリスタン・リ・ベール
source:
A cute shota type boy he's the prince of a neighboring country brought to be [url=https://vndb.org/c24777]Ultima's[/url] fiancé. He's known primarily as Bell.

[spoiler]Secretly he enjoys dressing as a girl.[/spoiler]
